heating-controller.paletteHelp: An extended PID controller for floor heating or radiators.
heating-controller.help:
This node provides an extended PID controller for floor heating or radiators. It needs the current temperature (y) and setpoint temperature (w) as input and outputs the valve state as int between 0 and 100.

EN can optionally be used to enable or disable the heating controller. When disabled the node outputs 0. The node generates an output at least once every 10 minutes.

PID Parameters

Kp
Proportional coefficient in % per °C
Ti
Integration time in seconds
Td
Differential coefficient in seconds
Setpoint low pass
Time constant of setpoint value low pass filter in seconds
Temperature low pass
Time constant of current temperature low pass filter in seconds (should be < 180 to avoid instability)
Valve state low pass
Time constant of valve state low pass filter in seconds (should be < 180 to avoid instability)

heating-controller.input1Description: Set to false to disable the heating controller. When disabled the node outputs 0 every 10 minutes. If not connected the heating controller is enabled by default. Note that the state is saved. So if this input is connected and set to false it will stay false until set to true again.

heating-cooling-controller.input4Description: HVAC mode input. When set to 0, it's "heating and cooling", when set to 1, "heating" and when set to 2, "cooling" only. Input is disabled if source for HVAC type is set to node.
heating-cooling-controller.output3Description: The currently selected HVAC type. Outputs 0 for "heating and cooling", 1 for "heating" and 2 for "cooling".

heating-mode.help: This node provides a way to manage and select heating modes. For the currently selected mode (a number between 0 and 10 on mI) the setpoint temperature can be set by using w. When the mode is selected the next time (using mI), this temperature is output on wO. Changes to mI are forwarded to mO. The input WIN can be connected to a window contact. When set to true, the mode is set to 0, the temperature set for this mode is output on wO and 0 is output on mO. When set to false, the temperature is reset to the last value and the previous mode is output on mO.
heating-mode.input1Description: Mode input. A value between 0 and 10 where 0 is the frost protection temperature.
heating-mode.input2Description: The setpoint temperature of the current mode. This value is stored and output on wO when the current mode is selected again.
heating-mode.input3Description: Window input. When set to true, the mode is set to 0 and the corresponding setpoint temperature is output.
